epithet: Where the Sky Is Put Down

places.name: The Skyfall Grove
places.epithet: Wood that remembers the storms that shaped it
places.text: A sacred forest of tall, storm-scarred trees grown under constant weather. Elven Loomwardens tend it as a shrine; wood taken from it, rarely and only with permission, is said to remember the storms that shaped it.

places.name: The Reach Tear
places.text: A standing rift at the edge of the town. The Loomwardens send surplus weather into it. What is on the other side has never been formally described.

places.name: The Loomwardens' House
places.epithet: Where the storms are set down
places.text: When the Loom Temple turns a storm away from the Union, the weather has to go somewhere; much of it is sent north and set down here, and the Loomwardens in this house decide where.

places.name: The Weaving Sheds
places.text: The Reach weaves cloth, mostly, one suspects, because nothing else wears out quite as fast there.

places.name: The Boot Hall
places.text: The bootmakers' hall; the Reach goes through boots faster than anywhere in the Union.

places.name: Copper Square
places.epithet: Low, rounded, and grounded with copper
places.text: The town square, with a copper rod at each corner. Every house in the Reach is built low and rounded, and grounded with copper.

places.name: The Skyfall Reach Road
places.text: Down the Northern Arm to Windperch, with a branch east toward the Iron Crucible.
